BiblicalUsage: Peras means to split up, to divide — the last word of the writing on the wall. The hand wrote MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN, and Daniel read it: PERES, thy kingdom is divided and given to the Medes and Persians.
TheologicalSignificance: What I hold is that a kingdom divided is a kingdom ended: God weighed Belshazzar, found him wanting, and split his throne in one night.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
